subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-like keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The source and docs show a real general-vs-coding endpoint split, but only a maintainer or credentialed tester can confirm the vendor entitlement contract and choose routing, catalog, or diagnostics behavior.

options.title: Validate Lite route first
options.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys on Coding Plan
options.body: If Lite keys are only valid for `volcengine-plan`, keep general models separate and add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics for Lite-key users.

options.title: Support shared key on both endpoints
options.body: If the same key should work on the general endpoint too, treat the 401 as a runtime/auth bug and fix the credential/header path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite route first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses provider auth aliases, bundled plugin ownership, setup defaults, and runtime compatibility surfaces where the history is strongest.
